summary: A Taiwan–Netherlands (NSTC–NWO) bilateral exchange linking NTU's E3 Research Group with the University of Groningen's ESRIG institute — anchored by the five-day NTU–UG Joint Seminar 2026, where six keynotes and 14+ young scholars built a shared agenda across sustainable energy, mobility, and resource governance.
summaryZh: 臺荷（國科會—NWO）雙邊交流計畫，連結臺大 E3 研究團隊與荷蘭格寧根大學 ESRIG 研究所，並以為期五天的「2026 NTU–UG 聯合研討會」為核心——透過六場主題演講與 14 位以上青年學者，建立涵蓋永續能源、運輸與資源治理的共同研究議程。

partners.name: University of Groningen (UG)
partners.role: Partner institution, Netherlands — ESRIG (Dr. Xin Sun)

outputs.title: NTU–UG Joint Seminar 2026 — 22–26 March, NCREE Taipei: four thematic forums, six keynotes, 14+ young-scholar talks, and a poster session
Planned co-authored high-impact journal papers on decarbonization digital twins, EV big-data, and renewable-energy forecasting
Standing PhD-student exchange and joint-supervision mechanism between NTU E3 and UG ESRIG

metaDescription: A Taiwan–Netherlands (NSTC–NWO) bilateral exchange between NTU's E3 group and the University of Groningen, anchored by the NTU–UG Joint Seminar 2026 on sustainable energy and mobility.
